{-# LANGUAGE StrictData #-}
{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}

module QuickType
    ( TopLevel (..)
    , Count (..)
    , Names (..)
    , Registry (..)
    , Scores (..)
    , Either (..)
    , ChoiceEntry (..)
    , EntryElement (..)
    , Empty (..)
    , Item (..)
    , Status (..)
    , Choice (..)
    , Next (..)
    , Pick (..)
    , decodeTopLevel
    ) where

import Data.Aeson
import Data.Aeson.Types (emptyObject)
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import Data.HashMap.Strict (HashMap)
import Data.Text (Text)

type Count = Int

type Names = [Text]

type Registry = HashMap Text Item

type Scores = HashMap Text Double

{-| The top level.

topLevelID:
An identifier.

name:
A name.
On two lines.
-}
data TopLevel = TopLevel
    { weirdNameTopLevel :: Text
    , emptyTopLevel :: Bool
    , aBTopLevel :: Text
    , topLevelABTopLevel :: Maybe Text
    , anythingTopLevel :: Maybe Value
    , choiceTopLevel :: Choice
    , topLevelEmptyTopLevel :: Empty
    , entriesTopLevel :: [EntryElement]
    , topLevelIDTopLevel :: Int
    , listMapTopLevel :: HashMap Text ([Text])
    , lookupTopLevel :: HashMap Text (HashMap Text Int)
    , matrixTopLevel :: [([Double])]
    , maybeListTopLevel :: Maybe (Maybe ([Int]))
    , maybeMapTopLevel :: Maybe (Maybe (HashMap Text Text))
    , nameTopLevel :: Text
    , nothingTopLevel :: Maybe Text
    , optionalEntryTopLevel :: Maybe EntryElement
    , pickTopLevel :: Pick
    , ratioTopLevel :: Double
    , statusTopLevel :: Status
    , tagsTopLevel :: [Text]
    , thisTopLevel :: Text
    , toStringTopLevel :: Text
    , uuidTopLevel :: Text
    , whenTopLevel :: Text
    } deriving (Show)

data Choice
    = BoolInChoice Bool
    | ChoiceEntryInChoice ChoiceEntry
    | IntegerInChoice Int
    | NullInChoice
    | StringArrayInChoice ([Text])
    | StringInChoice Text
    deriving (Show)

{-| An entry.

value:
The value.
-}
data ChoiceEntry = ChoiceEntry
    { nextChoiceEntry :: Maybe Next
    , valueChoiceEntry :: Maybe Double
    } deriving (Show)

data Next
    = DoubleInNext Double
    | EntryElementInNext EntryElement
    deriving (Show)

{-| An entry.

value:
The value.
-}
data EntryElement = EntryElement
    { nextEntryElement :: Maybe EntryElement
    , valueEntryElement :: Double
    } deriving (Show)

data Pick
    = DoubleInPick Double
    | StringInPick Text
    deriving (Show)

data Status
    = OpenStatus
    | ItSStatus
    | ABStatus
    | LineBreakStatus
    | NStatus
    | TypeStatus
    | PurpleStatus
    | FluffyStatus
    deriving (Show)

data Empty = Empty
    {
    } deriving (Show)

data Item = Item
    { labelItem :: Text
    } deriving (Show)

data Either
    = IntegerInEither Int
    | StringInEither Text
    deriving (Show)

decodeTopLevel :: ByteString -> Maybe TopLevel
decodeTopLevel = decode

decodeTopLevel :: ByteString -> Maybe Count
decodeTopLevel = decode

decodeTopLevel :: ByteString -> Maybe Names
decodeTopLevel = decode

decodeTopLevel :: ByteString -> Maybe Registry
decodeTopLevel = decode

decodeTopLevel :: ByteString -> Maybe Scores
decodeTopLevel = decode

decodeTopLevel :: ByteString -> Maybe Either
decodeTopLevel = decode

instance ToJSON TopLevel where
    toJSON (TopLevel weirdNameTopLevel emptyTopLevel aBTopLevel topLevelABTopLevel anythingTopLevel choiceTopLevel topLevelEmptyTopLevel entriesTopLevel topLevelIDTopLevel listMapTopLevel lookupTopLevel matrixTopLevel maybeListTopLevel maybeMapTopLevel nameTopLevel nothingTopLevel optionalEntryTopLevel pickTopLevel ratioTopLevel statusTopLevel tagsTopLevel thisTopLevel toStringTopLevel uuidTopLevel whenTopLevel) =
        object $ foldMap (maybe [] pure)
        [ Just $ "?>weird\nname" .= weirdNameTopLevel
        , Just $ "_" .= emptyTopLevel
        , Just $ "a b" .= aBTopLevel
        , ("a`b" .=) <$> topLevelABTopLevel
        , ("anything" .=) <$> anythingTopLevel
        , Just $ "choice" .= choiceTopLevel
        , Just $ "empty" .= topLevelEmptyTopLevel
        , Just $ "entries" .= entriesTopLevel
        , Just $ "id" .= topLevelIDTopLevel
        , Just $ "listMap" .= listMapTopLevel
        , Just $ "lookup" .= lookupTopLevel
        , Just $ "matrix" .= matrixTopLevel
        , ("maybeList" .=) <$> maybeListTopLevel
        , ("maybeMap" .=) <$> maybeMapTopLevel
        , Just $ "name" .= nameTopLevel
        , Just $ "nothing" .= nothingTopLevel
        , ("optionalEntry" .=) <$> optionalEntryTopLevel
        , Just $ "pick" .= pickTopLevel
        , Just $ "ratio" .= ratioTopLevel
        , Just $ "status" .= statusTopLevel
        , Just $ "tags" .= tagsTopLevel
        , Just $ "this" .= thisTopLevel
        , Just $ "toString" .= toStringTopLevel
        , Just $ "uuid" .= uuidTopLevel
        , Just $ "when" .= whenTopLevel
        ]

instance FromJSON TopLevel where
    parseJSON (Object v) = TopLevel
        <$> v .: "?>weird\nname"
        <*> v .: "_"
        <*> v .: "a b"
        <*> v .:! "a`b"
        <*> v .:! "anything"
        <*> v .: "choice"
        <*> v .: "empty"
        <*> v .: "entries"
        <*> v .: "id"
        <*> v .: "listMap"
        <*> v .: "lookup"
        <*> v .: "matrix"
        <*> v .:! "maybeList"
        <*> v .:! "maybeMap"
        <*> v .: "name"
        <*> v .: "nothing"
        <*> v .:! "optionalEntry"
        <*> v .: "pick"
        <*> v .: "ratio"
        <*> v .: "status"
        <*> v .: "tags"
        <*> v .: "this"
        <*> v .: "toString"
        <*> v .: "uuid"
        <*> v .: "when"

instance ToJSON Choice where
    toJSON (BoolInChoice x) = toJSON x
    toJSON (ChoiceEntryInChoice x) = toJSON x
    toJSON (IntegerInChoice x) = toJSON x
    toJSON NullInChoice = Null
    toJSON (StringArrayInChoice x) = toJSON x
    toJSON (StringInChoice x) = toJSON x

instance FromJSON Choice where
    parseJSON xs@(Bool _) = (fmap BoolInChoice . parseJSON) xs
    parseJSON xs@(Object _) = (fmap ChoiceEntryInChoice . parseJSON) xs
    parseJSON xs@(Number _) = (fmap IntegerInChoice . parseJSON) xs
    parseJSON Null = return NullInChoice
    parseJSON xs@(Array _) = (fmap StringArrayInChoice . parseJSON) xs
    parseJSON xs@(String _) = (fmap StringInChoice . parseJSON) xs

instance ToJSON ChoiceEntry where
    toJSON (ChoiceEntry nextChoiceEntry valueChoiceEntry) =
        object $ foldMap (maybe [] pure)
        [ ("next" .=) <$> nextChoiceEntry
        , ("value" .=) <$> valueChoiceEntry
        ]

instance FromJSON ChoiceEntry where
    parseJSON (Object v) = ChoiceEntry
        <$> v .:! "next"
        <*> v .:! "value"

instance ToJSON Next where
    toJSON (DoubleInNext x) = toJSON x
    toJSON (EntryElementInNext x) = toJSON x

instance FromJSON Next where
    parseJSON xs@(Number _) = (fmap DoubleInNext . parseJSON) xs
    parseJSON xs@(Object _) = (fmap EntryElementInNext . parseJSON) xs

instance ToJSON EntryElement where
    toJSON (EntryElement nextEntryElement valueEntryElement) =
        object $ foldMap (maybe [] pure)
        [ ("next" .=) <$> nextEntryElement
        , Just $ "value" .= valueEntryElement
        ]

instance FromJSON EntryElement where
    parseJSON (Object v) = EntryElement
        <$> v .:! "next"
        <*> v .: "value"

instance ToJSON Pick where
    toJSON (DoubleInPick x) = toJSON x
    toJSON (StringInPick x) = toJSON x

instance FromJSON Pick where
    parseJSON xs@(Number _) = (fmap DoubleInPick . parseJSON) xs
    parseJSON xs@(String _) = (fmap StringInPick . parseJSON) xs

instance ToJSON Status where
    toJSON OpenStatus = "open"
    toJSON ItSStatus = "it's"
    toJSON ABStatus = "a\\b"
    toJSON LineBreakStatus = "line\nbreak"
    toJSON NStatus = "Ünï"
    toJSON TypeStatus = "type"
    toJSON PurpleStatus = "_"
    toJSON FluffyStatus = ""

instance FromJSON Status where
    parseJSON = withText "Status" parseText
        where
            parseText "open" = return OpenStatus
            parseText "it's" = return ItSStatus
            parseText "a\\b" = return ABStatus
            parseText "line\nbreak" = return LineBreakStatus
            parseText "Ünï" = return NStatus
            parseText "type" = return TypeStatus
            parseText "_" = return PurpleStatus
            parseText "" = return FluffyStatus

instance ToJSON Empty where
    toJSON = \_ -> emptyObject

instance FromJSON Empty where
    parseJSON (Object _) = return Empty

instance ToJSON Item where
    toJSON (Item labelItem) =
        object $ foldMap (maybe [] pure)
        [ Just $ "label" .= labelItem
        ]

instance FromJSON Item where
    parseJSON (Object v) = Item
        <$> v .: "label"

instance ToJSON Either where
    toJSON (IntegerInEither x) = toJSON x
    toJSON (StringInEither x) = toJSON x

    parseJSON xs@(Number _) = (fmap IntegerInEither . parseJSON) xs
    parseJSON xs@(String _) = (fmap StringInEither . parseJSON) xs

{-# LANGUAGE StrictData #-}
{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}

module QuickType
  ( TopLevel (..)
  , Count (..)
  , Names (..)
  , Registry (..)
  , Scores (..)
  , Either (..)
  , ChoiceEntry (..)
  , EntryElement (..)
  , Empty (..)
  , Item (..)
  , Status (..)
  , Choice (..)
  , Next (..)
  , Pick (..)
  , decodeTopLevel
  ) where

import Data.Aeson
import Data.Aeson.Types (emptyObject)
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import Data.HashMap.Strict (HashMap)
import Data.Text (Text)

type Count = Int

type Names = [Text]

type Registry = HashMap Text Item

type Scores = HashMap Text Double

{-| The top level.

name:
A name.
On two lines.

topLevelID:
An identifier.
-}
data TopLevel = TopLevel
  { aBTopLevel :: Text
  , anythingTopLevel :: Maybe Value
  , choiceTopLevel :: Choice
  , emptyTopLevel :: Bool
  , entriesTopLevel :: [EntryElement]
  , listMapTopLevel :: HashMap Text ([Text])
  , lookupTopLevel :: HashMap Text (HashMap Text Int)
  , matrixTopLevel :: [([Double])]
  , maybeListTopLevel :: Maybe (Maybe ([Int]))
  , maybeMapTopLevel :: Maybe (Maybe (HashMap Text Text))
  , nameTopLevel :: Text
  , nothingTopLevel :: Maybe Text
  , optionalEntryTopLevel :: Maybe EntryElement
  , pickTopLevel :: Pick
  , ratioTopLevel :: Double
  , statusTopLevel :: Status
  , tagsTopLevel :: [Text]
  , thisTopLevel :: Text
  , toStringTopLevel :: Text
  , topLevelABTopLevel :: Maybe Text
  , topLevelEmptyTopLevel :: Empty
  , topLevelIDTopLevel :: Int
  , uuidTopLevel :: Text
  , weirdNameTopLevel :: Text
  , whenTopLevel :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

data Choice
  = BoolInChoice Bool
  | ChoiceEntryInChoice ChoiceEntry
  | IntegerInChoice Int
  | NullInChoice
  | StringArrayInChoice ([Text])
  | StringInChoice Text
  deriving (Show)

{-| An entry.

value:
The value.
-}
data ChoiceEntry = ChoiceEntry
  { nextChoiceEntry :: Maybe Next
  , valueChoiceEntry :: Maybe Double
  } deriving (Show)

data Next
  = DoubleInNext Double
  | EntryElementInNext EntryElement
  deriving (Show)

{-| An entry.

value:
The value.
-}
data EntryElement = EntryElement
  { nextEntryElement :: Maybe EntryElement
  , valueEntryElement :: Double
  } deriving (Show)

data Pick
  = DoubleInPick Double
  | StringInPick Text
  deriving (Show)

data Status
  = OpenStatus
  | ItSStatus
  | ABStatus
  | LineBreakStatus
  | NStatus
  | TypeStatus
  | PurpleStatus
  | FluffyStatus
  deriving (Show)

data Empty = Empty
  {
  } deriving (Show)

data Item = Item
  { labelItem :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

data Either
  = IntegerInEither Int
  | StringInEither Text
  deriving (Show)

instance ToJSON TopLevel where
  toJSON (TopLevel aBTopLevel anythingTopLevel choiceTopLevel emptyTopLevel entriesTopLevel listMapTopLevel lookupTopLevel matrixTopLevel maybeListTopLevel maybeMapTopLevel nameTopLevel nothingTopLevel optionalEntryTopLevel pickTopLevel ratioTopLevel statusTopLevel tagsTopLevel thisTopLevel toStringTopLevel topLevelABTopLevel topLevelEmptyTopLevel topLevelIDTopLevel uuidTopLevel weirdNameTopLevel whenTopLevel) =
    object $ foldMap (maybe [] pure)
    [ Just $ "a b" .= aBTopLevel
    , ("anything" .=) <$> anythingTopLevel
    , Just $ "choice" .= choiceTopLevel
    , Just $ "_" .= emptyTopLevel
    , Just $ "entries" .= entriesTopLevel
    , Just $ "listMap" .= listMapTopLevel
    , Just $ "lookup" .= lookupTopLevel
    , Just $ "matrix" .= matrixTopLevel
    , ("maybeList" .=) <$> maybeListTopLevel
    , ("maybeMap" .=) <$> maybeMapTopLevel
    , Just $ "name" .= nameTopLevel
    , Just $ "nothing" .= nothingTopLevel
    , ("optionalEntry" .=) <$> optionalEntryTopLevel
    , Just $ "pick" .= pickTopLevel
    , Just $ "ratio" .= ratioTopLevel
    , Just $ "status" .= statusTopLevel
    , Just $ "tags" .= tagsTopLevel
    , Just $ "this" .= thisTopLevel
    , Just $ "toString" .= toStringTopLevel
    , ("a`b" .=) <$> topLevelABTopLevel
    , Just $ "empty" .= topLevelEmptyTopLevel
    , Just $ "id" .= topLevelIDTopLevel
    , Just $ "uuid" .= uuidTopLevel
    , Just $ "?>weird\nname" .= weirdNameTopLevel
    , Just $ "when" .= whenTopLevel
    ]

instance FromJSON TopLevel where
  parseJSON (Object v) = TopLevel
    <$> v .: "a b"
    <*> v .:! "anything"
    <*> v .: "choice"
    <*> v .: "_"
    <*> v .: "entries"
    <*> v .: "listMap"
    <*> v .: "lookup"
    <*> v .: "matrix"
    <*> v .:! "maybeList"
    <*> v .:! "maybeMap"
    <*> v .: "name"
    <*> v .: "nothing"
    <*> v .:! "optionalEntry"
    <*> v .: "pick"
    <*> v .: "ratio"
    <*> v .: "status"
    <*> v .: "tags"
    <*> v .: "this"
    <*> v .: "toString"
    <*> v .:! "a`b"
    <*> v .: "empty"
    <*> v .: "id"
    <*> v .: "uuid"
    <*> v .: "?>weird\nname"
    <*> v .: "when"

instance ToJSON Choice where
  toJSON (BoolInChoice x) = toJSON x
  toJSON (ChoiceEntryInChoice x) = toJSON x

  toJSON NullInChoice = Null
  toJSON (StringArrayInChoice x) = toJSON x
  toJSON (StringInChoice x) = toJSON x

  parseJSON xs@(Bool _) = (fmap BoolInChoice . parseJSON) xs

  parseJSON Null = return NullInChoice
  parseJSON xs@(Array _) = (fmap StringArrayInChoice . parseJSON) xs
  parseJSON xs@(String _) = (fmap StringInChoice . parseJSON) xs
